senses.definition_en: the political beliefs or philosophy of Cristina Fernández de Kirchner; the bloc within La Cámpora adhering to or supporting such beliefs

examples.english: The Peronists under Miguel Pichetto and the Cristicamporismo in the Senate reached an agreement to vote in the session today for a scheme to end the authority to “recover theft” from the past, such as the ill-gotten goods from the records of payola scandals.
examples.ref: 2018 August 22, “Los senadores del PJ y del kirchnerismo acordaron avanzar con una ley anticorrupción "light"”, in MSN Noticias:
examples.text: El peronismo de Miguel Pichetto y el cristicamporismo en el Senado alcanzaron un acuerdo para votar en la sesión de hoy un proyecto de extinción de dominio que no podrá aplicarse para “recuperar lo robado” en el pasado, por ejemplo los bienes malhabidos en el escándalo de los cuadernos de las coimas.
examples.translation: The Peronists under Miguel Pichetto and the Cristicamporismo in the Senate reached an agreement to vote in the session today for a scheme to end the authority to “recover theft” from the past, such as the ill-gotten goods from the records of payola scandals.

examples.english: Cristicamporismo opposes direct appointment of the magistrates named by the government, to maintain the macrista arrangement.
examples.ref: 2019 April 6, Guido Braslavsky, “Tratan el pliego de once jueces en el Senado y hay tensión por el hijo del juez Hooft”, in Clarín:
examples.text: El cristicamporismo se niega directamente a designar magistrados propuestos por el Gobierno, en lo que queda de la gestión macrista.
examples.translation: Cristicamporismo opposes direct appointment of the magistrates named by the government, to maintain the macrista arrangement.

examples.english: Fernández is clear that the headquarters of Cristicamporismo, located 120 meters from the Congress, is the originative power of her candidacy, to which she needs to add the votes on the 27th of October above the Cristina ceiling.
examples.ref: 2019 September 16, Claudio Jacquelin, “Un superministro de economía: el plan de Alberto”, in La Nacion:
examples.text: Fernández tiene claro que en la sede del cristicamporismo, ubicada a 120 metros del Congreso, radica el poder originario de su candidatura y al que necesita relativizar con los votos que sume el 27 de octubre por encima del techo cristinista.
examples.translation: Fernández is clear that the headquarters of Cristicamporismo, located 120 meters from the Congress, is the originative power of her candidacy, to which she needs to add the votes on the 27th of October above the Cristina ceiling.

glosses: the political beliefs or philosophy of Cristina Fernández de Kirchner; the bloc within La Cámpora adhering to or supporting such beliefs
